title: Ring-2.6-1T: High-Performance Agentic MoE Model
summary: A massive 1-trillion parameter Mixture-of-Experts model optimized for complex reasoning and agentic workflows. It supports a 262K token context window and is specifically tuned for coding and tool-use.
research_notes: Released by InclusionAI (Ant Group); available for free on OpenRouter and integrated with Kilo Code.

evolution.summary: The 2.6 version introduces contextual process redundancy suppression to streamline Chain-of-Thought reasoning. It succeeds the Ring-2.5 series with improved efficiency in token generation and lower VRAM requirements.
